posts.body: Purchased one a couple of days ago for my partner but can't get on with it. Even though it has been used can I take back to get a refund ?

posts.body:
I guess you could sell it on as tried out (in working order) but not used but I don't think you can return it as it isn't faulty.

I used a manual one and found them ok as you're totally in control. But even they take a bit of practice.

posts.body: Before you scrap it, Is the pump the issue or that the milk is not let down because of the circumstances? Might be worth giving it a try when your partner is completely relaxed and holding the baby - health visitor or breastfeeding support group might be able to help.
